abstract: Approximately 30% of patients with disseminated testis cancer who receive platinum-based chemotherapy will experience normalization of tumor markers but have persistent, radiographically evident disease in the retroperitoneum. These patients usually undergo retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Of 557 patients undergoing post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection at our university medical center 45 (8.1%) had neoplastic elements distinct from the classical germ cell tumor types within the resected specimens. Examples include various sarcomas in 19 patients (3.7%), other nonsarcomatous nongerm cell cancers in 18 (3.2%) and cystic atypical choriocarcinoma in 8 (1.4%). No distinct patient characteristics or histological patterns in the primary tumor are predictive of these unusual findings in the retroperitoneal lymph node dissection specimen, although sampling error in the orchiectomy specimen could be the reason for this lack of correlation. Surgical resection of these chemoresistant tumors is potentially curative, with disease-free survival in 13 of 19 patients (68.4%) with sarcoma, 10 of 18 (55.6%) with nonsarcomatous cancer and 7 of 8 (87.5%) with cystic atypical choriocarcinoma at a mean followup of 30.6, 42.5 and 24.7 months, respectively.
abstract_ja: 白金製剤ベースの化学療法を受けた播種性精巣がん患者の約30%は、腫瘍マーカーが正常化するが、後腹膜に画像上明らかな病変が持続する。これらの患者は通常、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受ける。当大学医療センターで化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた557例のうち、45例(8.1%)が古典的な胚細胞腫瘍型とは異なる腫瘍成分を切除標本内に有していた。内訳は、肉腫19例(3.7%)、その他の非肉腫性非胚細胞性癌18例(3.2%)、嚢胞性非定型絨毛癌8例(1.4%)であった。これらの予期しない所見と、原発腫瘍の特定の患者特性や組織学的パターンとの間に相関は認められなかったが、これは精巣摘除術標本でのサンプリングエラーによる可能性がある。これらの化学療法抵抗性腫瘍の外科的切除は根治の可能性があり、平均追跡期間30.6、42.5、24.7か月で、肉腫19例中13例(68.4%)、非肉腫性癌18例中10例(55.6%)、嚢胞性非定型絨毛癌8例中7例(87.5%)で無病生存が得られた。
